description: The University of Trento publishes IAR-HP, an inventory of large hydropower systems in the northern Italian Alpine Region. It covers systems with installed capacity above 3 MW and describes structural, topological, operational and geographic characteristics. The repository lists an Excel workbook, CSV data, Shapefile archives and supporting reference material. Zenodo resolves the article-linked record to a newer deposited version, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15056372. Files are openly available and free under CC-BY-4.0. The landing metadata does not state a single observation date for all attributes, and the capacity threshold excludes small hydropower installations. Detailed variable definitions and network connectivity were not inspected inside the files. The inventory could help construct regional hydropower networks, compare capacity constraints or assess climate and hazard exposure after joining suitable hydrological forcing. It complements the dam and reservoir locations in data-geodar-georeferenced-global-dams-reservoirs with information specific to Italian Alpine hydropower systems.
